name: Michigan LEO MIOSHA Asbestos Abatement Contractor Search

agency.name: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity MIOSHA Asbestos Program

termsReviewNotes: Michigan.gov policies were reviewed. Source-specific redistribution approval for asbestos lookup fields has not been confirmed.
updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official MIOSHA asbestos contractor search before relying on freshness
knownExclusions: This source is limited to Michigan asbestos abatement contractor licenses.
Worker and supervisor accreditations, training providers, project notifications, general construction credentials, and local permits are separate records.
Specified licensed trade groups may have limited statutory exceptions for incidental asbestos work; those exceptions are not asbestos contractor licenses.
rateLimitNotes: No automated path is implemented. Use the official search manually and do not bypass technical controls.
publicRecordsNotes: Official source metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that another credential, exception, notification, permit, or authorization does not exist.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official MIOSHA licensing page links this JavaScript contractor search, which exposes name, license type, license number, city, and state search fields.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: The official path reviewed is a JavaScript lookup; no stable bulk export was confirmed.
researchNotes: Registry-only source for Michigan asbestos abatement contractor licenses.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Michigan asbestos abatement contractor licenses only.
No matching record means no match in the checked source at the checked time, not proof that another credential, exception, notification, permit, or authorization does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported adapter is exposed while the JavaScript application contract, access controls, privacy fields, and reuse position remain unreviewed.
maintainerNotes: A future permitted lookup adapter must preserve license type, source URL, checked time, caveats, raw record, and fingerprint.

researchEvidence.note: Official MIOSHA page reviewed; it states covered companies must be licensed before asbestos abatement and links the contractor search.
Official JavaScript search reviewed; it exposes contractor name, Type I or II, license number, city, and state filters.
Michigan.gov policies reviewed; source-specific redistribution approval remains outstanding.

blocker.summary: The official search is a JavaScript application without a reviewed stable public data contract or confirmed redistribution position.
